verdict.rationale: There is no explicit bulk-action feature. The evidence shows only adjacent many-at-once capabilities: an org-level cubic-config repo applies one cubic.yaml to every repository without its own config, a dedicated UI merges a whole PR stack in order, team data exports as CSV, and automatic review runs across all new PRs in selected repos. Fixes are per-comment ('Fix with cubic' on a review comment), and MCP triage is not described as batch. Missing for 10: explicit bulk actions on findings/PRs (e.g., bulk resolve, bulk fix, bulk re-review), batch operations via API/MCP/CLI, hands-on corroboration.
